title: Band-9 Samples: What’s your favorite TV programme/show? [Why?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 13 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 2 Test 1 question: “What’s your favorite TV programme/show? [Why?]” Sample 1 Female Male The sitcom “Friends” holds a special place in my heart, not just for its entertainment value, but also as a valuable tool in my language-learning journey. Its conversational dialogue, full of idiomatic expressions and colloquial language, provides an authentic context for understanding English as it is spoken in everyday life. Plus, the humor helps make the learning process enjoyable and memorable. It’s like having fun while learning, and that’s the best kind of education, in my opinion. Sample 2 Female Male My top pick for a television show would undoubtedly be Doraemon. It manages to strike a perfect balance between eliciting feelings of nostalgia, sparking curiosity about futuristic technology, and portraying the significance of friendships. I am transported back to my younger days every time I watch it, reminding me of the carefree joy of childhood. The future gadgets are a source of endless fascination, fueling my imagination. Above all, the unshakeable bond between the characters, especially Nobita and Doraemon, adds a warmth that makes the series deeply relatable. This multi-faceted experience makes Doraemon a unique and cherished favorite. Sample 3 Female Male “Game of Thrones” is my go-to when I want to escape from the humdrum of everyday life. The reason is quite simple – the rich fantasy world that the show presents is an exciting diversion. The intricate politics, epic battles, and complex characters create an immersive experience that transports me far away from my daily routine. Sample 4 Female Male “Breaking Bad” stands out as my favorite television drama. The transformation of the main character, Walter White, from a mild-mannered teacher to a feared drug lord, is both gripping and tragic. This show excellently demonstrates the potential consequences of making desperate choices, providing not only entertainment but also food for thought. Sample 5 Female Male To be honest, there’s not a television program that I’m particularly invested in at this moment. But when it comes to movies, I hold “Avengers: End Game” in high regard. What fascinates me is the way it brilliantly interweaves various storylines, bringing together a diverse array of superheroes from different backgrounds. It’s like a grand reunion, not only for the characters but also for the fans who have followed their journeys. Sample 6 Female Male Choosing a favorite TV program is a bit tricky for me. I tend to gravitate towards cooking and DIY shows, mainly because they offer practical knowledge that I can apply in my daily life. It’s not just about entertainment; for me, it’s also about learning and self-improvement. Sample 7 Female Male To be perfectly frank, it’s hard to settle on a favorite show. My tastes are so varied, spanning across different genres and styles. From gritty crime thrillers to light-hearted sitcoms, I find enjoyment in a multitude of programs. It’s this diversity that makes television a never-ending source of entertainment for me. Sample 8 Female Male Truth be told, I haven’t had a favorite television program in quite some time. With the demanding pace of life, I rarely find the time to commit to a series. When I do manage to squeeze in some TV time, I usually opt for news or short documentaries that can be consumed in small chunks. Sample 9 Female Male In an era of streaming services, I often find myself being more of a social viewer. I don’t have one particular favorite show; instead, my preferences are largely influenced by my friends’ recommendations. We often discuss the latest episodes, making my television viewing a more interactive and communal experience. Sample 10 Female Male If I have to be honest, I don’t have a typical favorite TV show. I predominantly watch business-focused reality shows and entrepreneur interviews. These types of programs offer a unique blend of entertainment and valuable insights into the world of entrepreneurship, which I find incredibly inspiring.
